title: Mixing changes the capital states
hook: Two stated cases: explore the stationary capital-residue distribution.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the stationary capital-residue distribution affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Drift, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the stationary capital-residue distribution in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy walk changes capital by ±1. Game A wins with 0.495; B wins with 0.095 at capital modulo 3 equal 0, otherwise 0.745. Independently choose A with chance 0.5. What is long-run mean drift, numerically iterated?
